text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday! I've prepared a present 
too~! From me... it's a whopping 100 kinds 
of fortune-telling!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my~ thank you so much~♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mountain fortune-telling, sea 
fortune-telling, amusement park, 
breakfast, lunch, dinner, kitties, tea 
fortune-telling, et cetera! I've prepared 
a rich and colorful variety for you!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Umm, I can really feel your enthusiasm... 
But today is Bright's birthday, so try to 
match her pace, okay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course! That's why there are 100 
varieties! No matter how your day goes, 
Bright-san, I've got you covered! A full, 
spot-on fortune just for you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~ I'm getting so excited~♪ Well 
then, let us be on our way right away~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
To the Mejiro villa~. The mountains and 
sea are all nearby. And of course, we can 
have meals there too~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Aiming to collect every fortune-telling 
result~♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, cutting into my sleep to brainstorm 
was totally worth it! Yes, yes, yes, let's 
definitely do it! Let's go for full 
completion!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, since it's a special occasion~. Fufu, 
looks like it's going to be a fun 
birthday~♪

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... I wonder if... we'll finish before 
today ends...?
